policy.text: UTF-8; surrounding spaces removed; no control, line-separator, replacement or subtitle markup, bidirectional overrides/isolates or caption-marker characters
policy.timing: integral milliseconds; 0 <= start < end; start >= previous end; end <= ceil(audio ms)

review.statement: Automatic speech recognition output is not certified. Hashes, strict structure, timing bounds and exact file agreement prove only that these files were derived consistently from the recorded native run; a person must review the transcript and captions against the audio before relying on them.

segmentation.statement: maxSegmentLength is a native segmentation target, not a guaranteed maximum or a readability certification. Cues over the target are published unchanged and counted. Cue boundaries come from the experimental native token-level timestamps and are not certified. The words are an unreviewed machine draft: a person must review every caption against the audio.
segmentation.unit: Unicode code points of the published cue text, surrounding spaces removed. The native count also includes the leading space of each space-led token, so it is never lower than this count: a cue over the target here was over it natively too.
